verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows engine is explicitly documented as an automation system defined by trigger events, run conditions, and actions, with a reference of 152 action types spanning Slack, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident ops (rootly-docs-16,17,29,41), plus rule-based Alert Routing (rootly-docs-10) and escalation policies (rootly-docs-39) that trigger actions on incoming events. This matches the story of defining rules that fire actions automatically on events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of workflow reliability at scale, and explicit documentation of AI-agent-initiated or LLM-driven rule creation rather than just AI actions within workflows.
